summary: Phase 149O.1H.5 -- HATP Timestamp Canonicalization Lexical Guard Widening: narrow repair of BLOCKING finding B-149O.1H.4-1, discovered by Phase 149O.1H.4's independent re-verification. Root cause: _FRACTIONAL_SECONDS_RE = re.compile(r'\.(\d+)(?=Z$|[+-]\d{2}:\d{2}$)') (149O.1H.3) anchored fraction detection on the timezone-suffix syntax following the fraction (literal Z or colon-separated +HH:MM/-HH:MM offset) rather than on the fraction itself, so non-colon offsets (+00, +0000) datetime.fromisoformat also accepts bypassed the guard entirely, reproducing the exact original B-149O.1H-1 collision (.0000001+00/.0000009+00 both canonicalizing to the identical instant). Repaired by re-anchoring fraction detection on the seconds field itself: _FRACTIONAL_SECONDS_RE = re.compile(r'(?<=:\d{2})[.,](\d+)'). The lookbehind requires two digits immediately preceded by a colon (the SS seconds field), independent of date/time separator (T or space) or what follows the fraction; the character class [.,] covers both the '.' and ',' decimal separators this runtime's datetime.fromisoformat accepts. Runtime probing (Python 3.14.5, not relying on documentation alone) independently discovered and closed an additional bypass class not previously tested: a ',' decimal separator, which the pre-repair regex (anchored on literal '\.') never matched through any suffix at all, including Z and colon offsets. Probed and confirmed the runtime's full offset grammar relevant to fractional precision: Z, +HH:MM/-HH:MM, +HH/-HH (non-colon 2-digit), +HHMM/-HHMM (non-colon 4-digit), naive (no offset), and a bare space date/time separator -- every form is now covered by the suffix-independent anchor. Verified the guard does not over-reach into full ISO-8601 grammar validation: multi-separator malformed forms (12:00:00.123.456Z, 12:00:00..123Z) are left to the downstream datetime.fromisoformat call to reject, as required; a documented, intentionally conservative fail-closed edge case (offset-embedded fractional seconds, e.g. +00:00:00.0000001) is over-rejected rather than disambiguated, since the parser itself discards that value unconditionally regardless of digit count and no collision can occur through it -- documented as out of scope per the governing prompt's anti-grammar-duplication guidance. Historical B-149O.1H.4-1 bypass evidence (.0000001+00/.0000009+00 collision, regex-level/parser-level/constructor-level reproduction) preserved as demonstrably reproducible evidence in tests/test_phase_149o_1h_4_hatp_timestamp_canonicalization_final_independent_reverification.py Section C, converted to run against an isolated importlib import of the pinned pre-repair commit (3d6b5a9a) rather than the live module, per repository convention (114 passed, +9 new: historical-evidence conversion plus 4 new live repair-verification tests confirming the current production module now rejects the same inputs). New suite tests/test_phase_149o_1h_5_hatp_timestamp_lexical_guard_widening.py: 130 passed -- covering runtime offset-grammar probing, the historical collision pair (now rejected via both parser and constructor), the full offset-suffix matrix for 7+ digits (always reject) and <=6 digits (downstream rules decide), millisecond-domain-rule preservation, Z/colon-offset/original-149O.1H.1 regressions, fraction-digit-extraction adversarial forms (multiple-dot attack, offset-digit non-counting), decimal-comma coverage, same-instant/distinct-instant equivalence across offset syntax, parser/constructor equivalence on every new suffix form, B-149O.1H-2 constructor-hardening regression, closed-schema/duplicate-key/AG3-AG5-discrimination regressions, golden-vector/digest/mutation-sensitivity checks, and a purity/forbidden-symbol audit. Files changed: src/pcae/core/human_approval_trusted_provenance.py (production, 18 insertions/5 deletions, exactly one file, UNRELATED=0 -- confirmed via git diff --stat), tests/test_phase_149o_1h_4_hatp_timestamp_canonicalization_final_independent_reverification.py (updated in place, historical-evidence conversion), tests/test_phase_149o_1h_5_hatp_timestamp_lexical_guard_widening.py (new), docs/PHASE_149O_1H_5_HATP_TIMESTAMP_CANONICALIZATION_LEXICAL_GUARD_WIDENING.md (new), PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, plus task-lifecycle files. Regressions: new 149O.1H.5 suite 130 passed; 149O.1H.4 suite (post-update) 114 passed; Wave-3 baseline (test_hatp_proof_models.py + test_hatp_canonical_serialization.py + test_phase_149o_1g_...py 100, test_phase_149o_1h_..._independent_verification.py 166, test_phase_149o_1h_1_..._domain_hardening.py 93, test_phase_149o_1h_2_..._reverification.py 99, test_phase_149o_1h_3_..._repair.py 57) 515 passed, matching the expected count exactly; combined Wave-3 baseline plus 149O.1H.4 plus 149O.1H.5: 759 passed; Wave-1/2 foundation (test_repository_identity.py + test_hatp_bootstrap_foundation.py + test_phase_149o_1e_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_...py + test_phase_149o_1f_1_...py) 103 passed; 149O.1F.2 90 passed; phase-report trust (test_phase_reports.py + test_phase_reports_cli.py + test_phase_report_trust_hard_fail.py + test_push_phase_report_identity_137f1.py) 201 passed; HATP contract/plan (test_phase_149o_1c_...py + test_phase_149o_1d_...py) 127 passed, no contract change (re-run clean after commit; the mid-phase dirty-tree state while the production edit was uncommitted transiently failed test_no_src_pcae_files_modified_this_phase, the same artifact class documented in 149O.1H.3's own report -- confirmed clean post-commit); RAE/Permission-Broker/agent broad selection (-k 'rae or permission_broker or agent') 1 failed / 5399 passed (test_phase_148f_..._test_permission_broker_consumer_scope_inventory, the same known pre-existing failure), RAE canonical-provenance suite run directly 4 failed / 13 passed (same 4 known pre-existing B-149O-1..4-related forgery findings already OPEN), combined pre-existing-failure total 5, matching the established baseline exactly, zero new failures; Fast Green (-m fast_green -n auto) 4531 passed, identical to the entering baseline, no regression (the new suite is deliberately not registered fast_green, matching this module's existing pattern -- no prior 149O.1H.x phase's new suite is either).
